killedBy: hud: the stats page reopens on the tab you last used, and starts a fresh document on Stats
why: The behaviour issue #322 asked to change, restored: the Main Menu's Records button opens the Stats tab whatever the player last used, so someone comparing achievements across runs re-clicks the tab on every visit. Survives the fresh-document case entirely -- a first visit opens on Stats either way -- which is why the reopen test drives a full switch/leave/return round trip rather than asserting the opening tab once.
